queries.result: First-party discovery found the municipality's official map and geographic-information page, its cadastral-value lookup procedure, and the municipal Planning/Cadastro Técnico department page. No anonymous parcel-feature service or geometry response was established.

queries.result: A pesquisa located the official Central de Mapas, the Cadastro Técnico department description, and the municipal Demonstrativo básico de valores de cadastro imobiliário. The map page lists PDFs/DWGs and approved subdivision plans, not a public parcel API; the DBV form requires a cadastral reference or number and does not expose geometry in the anonymous HTML.

registryCustodian: Municipality of Presidente Prudente, Secretaria de Planejamento, Desenvolvimento Urbano e Habitação, Departamento de Cadastro Técnico; the official department page describes maintenance of the Cadastro Imobiliário database and the municipal geoprocessing system. This is local custodian evidence, not evidence of an exposed parcel geometry service.
serviceReview: The official Central de Mapas page was fetched over TLS and its current HTML inspected. It exposes municipal map PDFs, DWG files, and approved subdivision-plan documents. No JavaScript map viewer, WMS/WFS, ArcGIS REST endpoint, parcel layer, schema, or CRS was exposed. The official DBV route https://www.presidenteprudente.sp.gov.br/servico/dbv/index.xhtml was fetched over TLS; its JSF form offers lookup by Referência cadastral or Número do cadastro and requires user-supplied cadastral identifiers. No lookup was submitted because no identifier was available and the route is a fiscal/cadastral-value procedure, not a safe anonymous geometry endpoint. No login, credential, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe-field request, or TLS exception was used.
